# Quaestio — full AI brief (llms-full.txt)

> The complete machine-readable reference: product, all 41 commands, hosting
> modes, pool API, architecture, security posture, and legal position.
> Short version: llms.txt. Skill list: skills.md. Agent auth: auth.md.
> API catalog: api-catalog.json. Agent card: agent.json.
> Canonical docs: https://quaestio.online/ — Contact: info@quaestio.online.

## 1. What Quaestio is

Quaestio is a free Discord AI companion and moderation/community bot with
self-hosted model support. One shared bot is invited to a server in one click;
no Discord application, bot token, or self-hosting is required to use it.
Compute comes from community hardware running local Ollama models
(qwen2.5 0.5b/1.5b/3b, llama3.2:3b, tinyllama). There is no paywall, no premium
tier, no commercial AI API in the loop. Code: proprietary, view-only —
https://github.com/fishesarethings/discord-ai-companion-bot-pool (bot),
https://github.com/fishesarethings/quaestio-admin (dashboard + pool broker),
https://github.com/fishesarethings/quaestio-site (website).

## 2. All 41 slash commands

AI: /ask <prompt>, @Quaestio mention chat (conversation mode keeps answering
follow-ups, `go away` ends it), /summarize [limit], /ai status (embed with
contributor badge), /ai model, /ai toggle, /ai personality (friendly, sage,
sarcastic, pirate, professional, feral gremlin, none), /ai character
(Jeff from Mars, Grumpy tavern keeper, Wholesome grandma, Cyber detective),
/ai clear (admin).
Levels: /rank, /profile (learned facts), /leaderboard.
Moderation (Administrator): /warn (auto-kick at limit), /warns, /delwarns,
/kick, /ban, /unban, /purge ≤100, /mute, /unmute.
Tags: /tag, /tagcreate, /tagdelete, /tags.
Birthdays: /birthday set|list|remove.
Core: /ping, /uptime, /about, /invite, /panel (opens https://admin.quaestio.online).
Games: /8ball, /dice [XdY], /coin, /rps, /slot, /trivia + /answer,
/tictactoe @friend + /move, /remind <what> <minutes>, /poll.
Pool: /pool (anonymous stats + leaderboard + perks pitch).

## 3. Hosting modes (no own-bot setup exists)

- Shared host (default): invite the bot, done.
- Own box: server admin points AI source at their Ollama in the panel.
- Community pool: anyone runs `quaestio pool-serve` (outbound HTTPS only,
  NAT-proof) or hosts in the browser via WebGPU on https://pool.quaestio.online.
Contributors earn priority routing, share-scaled request limits (2–4x), and a
gold contributor badge. Pool names are random node-xxxx IDs; endpoints and
models are Fernet-encrypted at rest; routing is weighted-random with automatic
failover, cooldown parking, and reputation fail-parks.

## 4. Data and security (see /security.html)

- Discord → bot: message text being answered + display names (as Name[1234] tags).
- Bot → model host: prompt + sampling settings over TLS. Assume a pool node
  can technically read prompts routed to it — routing is random and anonymous.
- Stored: SQLite (guild/user IDs, XP counters, tags, warnings, settings,
  conversation memory, learned facts, birthdays). Pool broker keeps node IDs,
  encrypted endpoints/models, served counts, health timestamps; job rows are
  deleted after delivery.
- No trackers, cookies, ads, or data sale. Admin panel uses Discord OAuth;
  the project never asks for Discord passwords.
- Installers: one-line shell/PowerShell into ~/quaestio (venv, deps, Ollama,
  one model, optional pool registration). Review source in the bot repo.
  Uninstall: `quaestio uninstall`.

## 5. AI behavior notes

Small local models: concise 1–2 sentence replies, persona via system role,
per-personality sampling, anti-hallucination grounding, flood-guard abuse
control (no quotas), one-at-a-time fair queue with typing indicators.
AI output may be wrong — informational/entertainment only.

## 6. Legal position (see /terms.html, /privacy.html)

Provided as-is, no warranties, no commitment to availability, accuracy, or
support. No liability for data loss, account actions, moderation outcomes, or
AI output. Operators may change or discontinue anything at any time. Users run
at their own risk; server operators are responsible for their servers.
Contact: info@quaestio.online.
